game: Akumajou Dracula Mokushiroku - Real Action Adventure (J)

cheats.name: Level Select
cheats.note: You must use this code on a saved game, because the intro to the first level will mess up the game. Now select the saved game, and hold down the GS button until the level loads. Some of the boss stages will not let you fight the boss unless you re-enter the area. Also, with the part of stage modifier, the second code modifies the part of the level that you are in, and 0000 is the level's start.

cheats.name: Open All Doors and Gates,No Bosses
Switch From
cheats.note: This Switch From Cheat lets you switch characters on a saved game For example, if you are Reindhart and you want to be Carrie in the middle of your game save it and then enable this Cheat and press F1. when you start your saved game back up you'll be Carrie instead of Reindhart.
